candidates.title: Composable CXL Memory as a Kubernetes-Native Shared Memory for LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Recent systems work that makes composable CXL memory a Kubernetes-schedulable shared KV-cache tier and reports 5.5x-36.6x TTFT reduction from cross-node prefix reuse.

candidates.title: HyMCache: A KV Cache Framework for Multi-Turn LLM Serving with CXL-Hybrid Memory
candidates.reason: Directly relevant CXL-plus-SSD hybrid-memory KV caching; uses request-level prefetch and write buffering on a real prototype and compares against LMCache and Mooncake.

candidates.title: PAM: Processing Across Memory Hierarchy for Efficient KV-centric LLM Serving System
candidates.reason: Adjacent hierarchical-memory/PIM serving design that jointly places KV tokens and attention computation across heterogeneous memory tiers, useful for cross-lineage memory scheduling ideas.

candidates.title: Heterogeneous LLM Serving with General-Purpose Processing-Near-Memory for Retrieval-Based Sparse Attention
candidates.reason: Strong adjacent PNM/GPU co-serving paper for million-token sparse attention; moves KV/index operations to general-purpose near-memory nodes and reports 2.09-6.13x throughput-per-TDP under SLO.

discovery_stats.query_summary: Rotated after an all-known MoE/NVMe round into adjacent CXL shared memory, SSD-backed hybrid KV tiers, hierarchical PIM, and PNM sparse-attention serving. Evaluated four strong primary-source candidates.
discovery_stats.next_axis_hint: If final repository dedupe removes most candidates, rotate next to OS paging, GPU virtual-memory/runtime, storage scheduling, and networking mechanisms rather than repeating CXL.
